>>   233| Please see the [project license](about.md#license) for further details.

     236| Note that IDs are created from the text of a header. All text is converted to
     237| lowercase and any disallowed characters, including white-space, are converted to
     238| dashes. Consecutive dashes are then reduced to a single dash.
